messages:
maria: Heads up — trying to push redwood-api@2026.03.17-rc3 to prod now, but deploy-bot blocked me with a permission/MFA error. Change window is 18:00-19:00 PST. Can someone with prod-deploy role assist?

deploy-bot: Deploy request queued by maria for redwood-api@2026.03.17-rc3. Approval required: prod-deploy. MFA check: FAILED for user maria. To continue, run `/request-jit prod-deploy <duration>` or have an approver escalate.

sam-ops: I see — maria isn't in the deployer group (platform-eng). We can either JIT her or create a short-lived svcacct token. @priya can you approve if needed?

priya: I'm in a meeting until 18:15 PST. If this needs to go during the window I can hit approve at ~18:20. If it's blocking right now we can do a 30m svcacct token. MFA has to be noted in the audit.

maria: I can't complete MFA — my phone enrollment got reset while traveling. SSO ticket open but ETA unknown. We need this patch out to avoid a rollback cascade.

jwalter: If urgent, I can create a constrained service-account token for maria with a 30m TTL scoped only to the deploy job. That avoids break-glass on human MFA. Need a quick owner approval and an audit message. @sam-ops confirm?

sam-ops: +1 for svcacct. Prefer that to bypassing MFA for a user. Confirm scope: deploy:prod only, and pin version to rc3.

maria: svcacct would work for me. Thanks. What's the command?

jwalter: Running now — will restrict token to the single service and pin operation. ETA ~3-5m.

jwalter: ```bash
# create short-lived token limited to prod deploy
rci auth token create --principal svc_redwood_deploy_jit --ttl 30m --scopes "deploy:prod" --note "jit-2145012345 maria pin"
# then pass token to deploy-bot via secure CI var
```

deploy-bot: Token accepted. Initiating deploy: redwood-api@2026.03.17-rc3. Pin applied for rollout. Rollout policy: canary 10% -> 100% over 20m. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 2% sustained over 5m.

priya: I'll watch the canary metrics and approve full rollout if steady. :eyes:

oncall: I'll monitor latency and error alerts, standing by to trigger rollback if anything spikes.

maria: Adding audit note: "temporary svcacct token created by jwalter for maria to execute prod deploy due to MFA outage; window 18:05-18:35; scope deploy:prod; reason: urgent fix delivery/prevent rollback cascade."

sam-ops: Noted in audit log. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:

priya: Thanks @jwalter for quick turnaround. We'll follow up with SSO to re-enroll maria's device.

maria: Appreciate it, team. Deploy in progress.
